ticket.title: Export your flight history
ticket.description: Passengers should be able to download a CSV of their own completed flights.
requirements: Require the caller to be signed in.
Return only the flight history belonging to the signed-in passenger.
Return the selected history as a CSV download.

pr.title: Add flight history CSV export
pr.description: Adds an endpoint that lets a passenger download a flight history by its ID.
pr.author: nova-dev

aiReview.summary: The ticket asks for the signed-in passenger's own history. Trace how the request identifies a history and what the endpoint verifies before returning it.

findings.title: Inspect the history lookup and access checks
findings.detail: Check whether the requested history is tied to the current passenger, beyond verifying that someone is signed in.

proposedAnswer.reason: Authentication does not prove that the requested flight history belongs to the signed-in passenger.
